```
GOAL  G0: Achieve( Surveyed(region) ∧ Sampled(F₁,F₂,F₃ : distinct) ∧ Transmitted(report) )

G0  ≡  AND

## 2. Hierarchical Task Network

| ID | Task | Type | Pre | Post | Cost |

| P0.1 | `Deploy[arrays, arm, HGA]` | primitive | landed | deployed | 0.2 sol, 150 Wh |

| P0.4 | `BaselineImage[360° pan, navcam]` | primitive | deployed | panorama_0 | 0.2 sol |
| P0.5 | `Uplink[status, panorama_0]` | primitive | health ok | Earth has state | 1 pass |

### Phase P1 — Strategic Reconnaissance & Survey Planning (Sol 3–12)

**Compound task** `P1: BuildGeologicMap(region)` decomposes as:

```
P1 ≡ AND( P1.1 TraverseLoop, P1.2 RemoteSensing, P1.3 FeatureExtraction,
          P1.4 DiversityScoring, P1.5 TargetRanking, P1.6 PlanApproval )
```

| ID | Task | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| P1.1 | `TraverseLoop[3 waypoints, ≤ 500 m total]` | Star-pattern out-and-back from lander; each leg `DriveTo → Stop → Pan` |
| P1.2 | `RemoteSensing[Mastcam-Z multispectral + ChemCam-class LIBS at ≥ 12 stations]` | 3–5 m standoff; no contact required → cheap diversity screening |
| P1.3 | `FeatureExtraction[segment outcrops, floats, veins, regolith units; extract 9 attributes]` | Attributes: lithology, texture/grain size, bedding/stratigraphy, mineral class, alteration index, color/albedo, morphology, context (in-place vs float), access cost |
| P1.4 | `DiversityScoring[score each feature on 6 orthogonal axes]` | Axes: (i) emplacement process, (ii) mineralogical class, (iii) alteration state, (iv) grain size/texture, (v) stratigraphic position, (vi) organic-carbon potential |
| P1.5 | `TargetRanking[select top-5 by diversity-greedy + access-cost penalty]` | Greedy set-cover: maximize pairwise diversity, minimize traverse Wh/m |
| P1.6 | `Uplink[map, scores, proposed 5-target list] → await approval` | 1–2 sols turnaround |

**Exit gate:** ≥ 6 distinct candidate features scored; ≥ 5 retained; Earth-approved target list with a **primary + 2 backups per slot**.

---

```

| ID | Subtask | Primitives / detail | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|

| T(i).4 | **Select sample point** | `ScoreIlluminationAndSlope` → `CheckDrillFootprint[flatness ≤ 5°, no fracture, arm reach]` → `ConfirmTarget` | 0.3 sol |
| T(i).5 | **Acquire sample** | `Abrade[2 mm]` → `Imager[abraded patch]` → `Drill[core, 5 cm]` → `VerifyCoreInTube[sensor]` → `SealTube[id]` | 1–2 sols, 400 Wh |

**Slot plan (diversity-greedy ordering, nearest-first with diversity constraint):**

| Slot | Target class | Rationale for diversity |
|---|---|---|
| i=1 | F₁ — layered sedimentary outcrop (mudstone/clay) | Fine-grained, aqueous, highest biosignature-preservation potential |
| i=2 | F₂ — igneous bedrock/float (basaltic) | Contrasts emplacement process + mineral class; anchors provenance |
| i=3 | F₃ — sulfate/vein hydrothermal alteration zone | Distinct alteration state; records fluid chemistry |

## 3. Resource Budgets (nominal 75-sol campaign)

| Resource | Budget | Planned | Reserve |
|---|---|---|---|
| Energy | ~195 kWh available | ≤ 150 kWh used | 23 % |
| Traverse distance | 20 km design | ~6–8 km | large |
| Sample tubes | 38 + 5 blanks | 4–5 used | 33+ for Phase 2 |
| Downlink | ~150 Mbit/sol | avg 80 Mbit | — |
| Command cycles | 1 uplink/sol | 1–2 sols per major decision | — |

---

## 4. State Model (what the planner reasons over)

`At(rover, pose)`, `Charged(w)`, `Healthy(subsystem)`, `Imaged(feature)`, `Scored(feature, diversity_vec)`, `Sampled(feature, tube_id)`, `Sealed(tube)`, `Cached(tube)`, `Documented(feature)`, `Downlinked(product)`, `Acked(product)`.

Goal formula, restated operationally:

```
∃ f₁,f₂,f₃ : Sampled(fₖ, tₖ) ∧ Sealed(tₖ) ∧ Cached(tₖ) ∧ Documented(fₖ)
            ∧ |{class(fₖ)}| = 3
            ∧ Acked(R1)
```

---

## 5. Decision Rules Embedded in the Planner

1. **Diversity-greedy target selection** — never sample a feature whose `class` vector is within a similarity threshold of an already-sampled one, unless it adds a new stratigraphic position.
2. **Energy-gated commitment** — a sampling slot may only start if `Charged ≥ slot_cost × 1.35`.
3. **Two-strike rule** — if a target fails characterization twice (arm unreachable, drill fault, rock too hard), the OR-node rebinds to the backup target.
4. **Opportunistic upgrade** — any unplanned high-value feature discovered en route with diversity score > current slot's is escalated to the next slot *only if* traverse cost < 40 % of remaining reserve.
5. **Report-first priority** — under comm degradation, Tier-1 report always preempts raw data.

---

## 6. Risk Register & Contingencies

| Risk | Trigger | Response |
|---|---|---|
| Safe mode / fault | Watchdog trip | `EnterSafeMode → Downlink fault → await Earth → ResumeOrReplan(P0.2)` |
| Drill jam / no core | `VerifyCoreInTube = false` | Retract, `Abrade` alternative, or rebind to backup target; log tube as empty |
| Hazardous terrain on route | Costmap all-paths > slope limit | Local re-route; if none within 2 sols → skip target, rebind |
| Dust storm / low power | `Charged < 30 %` | Halt traverse, low-power posture, defer sampling |
| Comm outage | 2 consecutive missed passes | Conserve data, attempt X-band DTE, continue survey-only until restored |
| Arm/workspace failure | 2 consecutive contact faults | Drop to remote-sensing-only mode; still meet `Surveyed(region)`, flag `Sampled < 3` as a *partial-goal failure* requiring Earth decision |
| Sample tube capacity issue | Carousel fault | Halt caching, preserve sealed tubes in arm, replan |

---

## 7. Verification / Replanning Gates

| Gate | After | Criterion | On failure |
|---|---|---|---|
| V1 | P0 | All subsystems nominal, pose known | Safe mode |
| V2 | P1 | ≥ 5 ranked targets, Earth-approved | Re-survey 2 sols |
| V3 | each P2(i) | `Sealed ∧ Cached ∧ Documented` | Two-strike replan |
| V4 | P2 complete | ≥ 3 distinct classes sampled | Extend loop with backup target |
| V5 | P4 | Integrity log clean, every claim cited | Regenerate report |
| V6 | P5 | Earth ACK received | Retransmit |

---

## 8. Execution Summary (single-line timeline)

```
Sol 0–2   P0 Commission & Localize
Sol 3–12  P1 Recon → geologic map → diversity scoring → Earth-approved target list
Sol 13–30 P2(1) Sedimentary F₁  (traverse → characterize → core → seal → cache → document)
Sol 31–45 P2(2) Igneous   F₂
Sol 46–60 P2(3) Hydrothermal F₃      ⟵ goal's minimum completeness reached here
Sol 61–68 P3 Final sweep + optional regolith F₄
Sol 69–72 P4 Consolidate audit, products, validated report R1
Sol 73–75 P5 Tiered downlink + Earth ACK  ⟶ G0 satisfied
```

**Mission is declared complete only when three geologically distinct, sealed, cached, context-documented samples exist and Earth has acknowledged receipt of report R1.**"}

## 5. Decision Rules Embedded in the Planner

1. **Diversity-greedy target selection** — never sample a feature whose `class` vector is within a similarity threshold of an already-sampled one, unless it adds a new stratigraphic position.
2. **Energy-gated commitment** — a sampling slot may only start if `Charged ≥ slot_cost × 1.35`.
3. **Two-strike rule** — if a target fails characterization twice (arm unreachable, drill fault, rock too hard), the OR-node rebinds to the backup target.
4. **Opportunistic upgrade** — any unplanned high-value feature discovered en route with diversity score > current slot's is escalated to the next slot *only if* traverse cost < 40 % of remaining reserve.
5. **Report-first priority** — under comm degradation, Tier-1 report always preempts raw data.

## 6. Risk Register & Contingencies

| Risk | Trigger | Response |
|---|---|---|
| Safe mode / fault | Watchdog trip | `EnterSafeMode → Downlink fault → await Earth → ResumeOrReplan(P0.2)` |
| Drill jam / no core | `VerifyCoreInTube = false` | Retract, `Abrade` alternative, or rebind to backup target; log tube as empty |
| Hazardous terrain on route | Costmap all-paths > slope limit | Local re-route; if none within 2 sols → skip target, rebind |
| Dust storm / low power | `Charged < 30 %` | Halt traverse, low-power posture, defer sampling |
| Comm outage | 2 consecutive missed passes | Conserve data, attempt X-band DTE, continue survey-only until restored |
| Arm/workspace failure | 2 consecutive contact faults | Drop to remote-sensing-only mode; still meet `Surveyed(region)`, flag `Sampled < 3` as a *partial-goal failure* requiring Earth decision |
| Sample tube capacity issue | Carousel fault | Halt caching, preserve sealed tubes in arm, replan |
